❓ FAQ

Frequently asked questions

How do I receive the ebook?
Instantly. Right after checkout you'll see a download button on screen and receive a download link by email. You get both PDF and EPUB, so you can read on any phone, tablet, e-reader app, or computer.
Do I need a gym membership or equipment?
No. Every workout in the book is designed for your living room in about 15 minutes, using bodyweight only. Optional dumbbell variations are included if you want them, but they're never required.
I've failed every diet before. Why would this be different?
Because it was designed for exactly that person. No banned foods to rebel against, workouts short enough to survive a busy week, and a habit system built specifically to carry you past the week-2 motivation dip. And if it's still not for you, you're covered by the 7-day refund.
How much weight can I realistically lose?
We won't promise you a number — run from anyone who does. The plan is built around a safe, sustainable rate of 1–2 lbs per week, and most readers finish the 45 days down somewhere between 7 and 15 lbs. Individual results vary based on your starting point, consistency, and lifestyle.
Is it suitable for beginners or people over 50?
Yes. Every workout includes beginner variations, and the nutrition framework works with any cooking skill or budget. If you have a medical condition or haven't exercised in a long time, check with your doctor first — the ebook tells you the same.
Is this medical advice?
No. The ebook is educational content, not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before starting any nutrition or exercise program.
What if it doesn't work for me?
Just reply to your receipt email within 7 days and we'll refund 100% of your purchase — no questions, no forms. You can even keep the four bonuses as a thank-you for trying it.
What exactly do I get, again?
The complete 150+ page ebook (PDF + EPUB), four printable bonuses (meal planner, grocery swap guide, workout library, habit tracker pack), and free lifetime updates — all delivered instantly for a one-time payment of $27.
